hypotheses.persona: Industrial/Construction Worker with Early Start & Late Return
hypotheses.rationale: Strong prior evidence of industrial gear (hi-vis, badge) and consistent early departures (05:00-05:10) on 4 out of 5 workdays. Day 8 was likely an outlier or shift variation. Day 9 returns to the 05:00 pattern, reinforcing the primary hypothesis.

Day 8 showed a late start (11:22 badge, 13:28 keys). While Day 9 reverted to early start, the existence of at least one late start suggests the schedule is not rigidly fixed to 05:00, allowing for variable shifts or occasional late starts.

selected_evidence: Day 0, 05:14 — thermos at counter_k1 (early morning prep for long shift)
Day 2, 14:42 — hi_vis_vest at locker_shelf_e1 (strong discriminator: industrial job)
Day 3, 13:19 — hi_vis_vest at elsewhere (confirms worker is on-site midday)
Day 4, 05:08 — work_badge at entry_hook_e1 (confirms work gear retrieval, early start)
Day 4, 05:23 — keys at elsewhere (confirms departure with work gear)
Day 5, 12:25 — phone at sofa_l1 (weekend relaxation, no work gear present)
Day 5, 19:01 — fork at sink_k1 (weekend domestic routine, dinner prep)
Day 6, 18:53 — fork at sink_k1 (Sunday evening domestic routine, consistent with Day 5)
Day 7, 05:09 — work_badge at entry_hook_e1 (confirms recurring Monday early start pattern)
Day 9, 04:49 — thermos at counter_k1 (early morning prep, confirms return to early routine after Day 8 anomaly)
Day 9, 05:04 — work_badge at elsewhere (departure with work gear, consistent with 05:00 norm)
notes: Day 9 (Wednesday) shows a return to the 05:00 departure pattern (thermos at 04:49, badge at 05:04). This suggests Day 8 (Tuesday) was indeed an outlier or a specific shift variation rather than a permanent schedule change. The 'Industrial Worker' hypothesis remains dominant. The 'Shift Worker' hypothesis is retained at lower probability to account for the Day 8 anomaly. Need to monitor Day 10 (Thursday) and Day 11 (Friday) to see if the 05:00 pattern holds for the rest of the week. If Day 10 is also early, the Day 8 anomaly is likely isolated.
